name: FX Fix Reversal
entry: Long USD pre-Tokyo 17:00-20:55 ET and pre-ECB 2:00-8:15 ET (ECB fix moved to 16:00 CET Jul-2016)
exit: Reverse: short USD post-Tokyo 20:55-2:00 and post-London 11:00-17:00 ET
sizing: Equal notional per pair / dollar portfolio
ann_return_src: EUR Europe window 15.6%/yr; GBP 12.4%; CHF 12%; Tokyo 6.2-14.2% (gross)
figure_tags: VERIFIED (returns gross; authors: net negative for liquidity demander 2006-2019)
screen_status: Pass only if ECN cost <=~0.5bp/side (to verify)
score_reason: Best diversifier, structural mechanism; cost is the key risk

name: Front-running Rebalancers (SPY vs IEF)
entry: w = avg(-Threshold/1.5%, modified Calendar sign); long SPY/short IEF if w>0 else reverse
exit: Daily rebalance, hold to next close
score_reason: Explicit rules, net Sharpe ~1, cheap instruments

name: Turn-of-the-Month / Dash for Cash
source_authors: McConnell & Xu; Etula, Rinne, Suominen, Vaittinen
entry: Long at close T-2 (or T-4 per Etula) before last trading day; shift per settlement (T+2 2017, T+1 2024)
exit: Exit close of 3rd trading day of new month
score_reason: Simple, cheap, mechanism; widely known, long-only beta

name: EURUSD Time-of-Day
entry: Short EUR during European morning (07:00-15:00 local); long EUR during US hours (08:00-16:00 NY)
sharpe_src: 1.3 (morning short), 0.9 (afternoon long) net of EBS spread
score_reason: Cheap add-on to #1, needs own OOS
